description: Unlink a control from a custom risk (write — editor+ role). The control and risk both remain; only the mapping is removed. Unlinking clears an accepted exception's approval.

risk_code.description: Custom risk code in R-ORG-N format (e.g., 'R-ORG-1') — obtain from scf_list_custom_risks

scf_id.description: SCF control ID to unlink (e.g., 'AST-01') — obtain from scf_list_custom_risk_controls

name: scf_remove_custom_risk_control
